description: This source file implements the socket_thread class for managing socket connections, message handling, and communication over Unix Domain Sockets (UDS) and TCP/IP, including message verification and connection management within the prplMesh project.

classes.name: socket_thread
classes.description: A class managing socket connections, message reception, and processing for the prplMesh project, supporting both TCP and UDS communication.

methods.name: socket_thread::socket_thread
methods.description: Constructor initializing the socket_thread object with a specified Unix socket path.

methods.name: socket_thread::set_server_max_connections
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of server socket connections.

methods.name: socket_thread::init
methods.description: Initializes the server socket, either TCP or UDS, and prepares it for accepting connections.

methods.name: socket_thread::set_select_timeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for the select() call in milliseconds.

methods.name: socket_thread::skip_next_select_timeout
methods.description: Skips the next select timeout by setting it to zero.

methods.name: socket_thread::socket_disconnected_uds
methods.description: Checks if a UDS socket has been disconnected and handles cleanup.

methods.name: socket_thread::handle_cmdu_message_uds
methods.description: Processes an incoming CMDU message over UDS, including header verification and parsing.

methods.name: socket_thread::verify_cmdu
methods.description: Verifies the integrity and validity of a CMDU message, including TLV checks and magic number validation.

methods.name: socket_thread::work
methods.description: Main loop handling socket events, incoming connections, and message processing.
